consent.title: Cookies and privacy
consent.description: Necessary technologies let you use Bandanize. Optional purposes stay disabled until you accept them, and you can change your choice at any time.
consent.essential_only: We use necessary storage for your session, preferences and Bandanize features. You can read the details and review your settings.
consent.necessary_description: These maintain your session, remember your cookie choice and the app options you request.
consent.no_optional: No optional purposes are currently available in the consent manager. None are authorised by default.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.cookies_intro: Cookies are small pieces of data a browser saves for a website. Bandanize also uses local storage and browser caching; not all this storage is a cookie.
legal.session_purpose: Keep you signed in and display your user.
legal.until_logout: Until sign-out, invalidation or clearing browser data.
legal.language_duration: Cookie: 7 days. Local storage: until changed or cleared.
legal.days_7: Up to 7 days; removed after joining.
legal.cache_duration: Until the cache is updated or cleared.
legal.technical_storage: Session and preference storage is not permission for advertising or analytics. Clearing browser data may sign you out and reset your choices.
legal.cookies_control: Reject optional purposes, choose them individually or withdraw your choice using “Cookie settings” in every page's footer. Rejecting them does not prevent account access. External services you open may use their own cookies.
legal.contact_pending: The project maintainers still need to confirm their identity and contact email.
legal.welcome_purpose: Remember that you dismissed the introduction.

calendar_link.title: Google Calendar
calendar_link.description: Subscribe once to receive events and changes. Google decides when to fetch this calendar again; updates are not immediate.
calendar_link.fallback: If you have not subscribed yet, add this link in Google Calendar → Other calendars → From URL. Keep this link private: it grants access to the events.
calendar_link.copy_manually: Could not copy. Select the URL and copy it manually.
calendar_link.existing: Already added it? Open it in Google Calendar. Adding it again does not refresh it and may report that the calendar already exists.
calendar_link.delay: If changes are missing, wait for Google’s next refresh. Downloading and importing an .ics file creates a snapshot that does not update.
calendar_link.zone_help: The date and time above belong to this zone. Each member will see their local time.
calendar_link.invalid_zone: Choose a valid time zone, such as Europe/Madrid.
calendar_link.save_error: Could not save. Check the date and time zone; some times do not exist during daylight-saving changes.
calendar_link.download_error: Could not download the calendar. Please try again.

guide_ui.title: Your Bandanize guide
guide_ui.description: From your first project to your next rehearsal, all in one place.
guide_ui.reopen: Come back any time from your account → Bandanize guide.

intro.title: A space to make music
intro.body: Bring songs, ideas and people together without losing track of messages and files.
intro.tip1: Works for solo projects and bands alike.
intro.tip2: Start with one project and add what you need at your own pace.

project.title: Create your project and invite
project.body: From “Your Projects”, create a musical project with its name and image. This is where your group meets.
project.tip1: Invite your collaborators from Members, including by sharing a link.
project.tip2: Switch between multiple projects from the project name in the header.

songs.title: Organize your repertoire
songs.body: Create playlists for a live set, an album or your next ideas. Add your songs inside each list.
songs.tip1: Keep each song’s BPM, key and files together.
songs.tip2: Drag to reorder; between playlists, choose to move or duplicate.

tabs.title: Work on each part of the song
tabs.body: Add tablatures by instrument and leave comments on a specific passage.
tabs.tip1: Mention your collaborators to ask them to review a part.
tabs.tip2: Use fullscreen, adjust the font or hide comments for comfortable reading.

team.title: Plan your next rehearsal
team.body: Talk in chat, follow updates in notifications and schedule rehearsals and shows in the calendar.
team.tip1: Everyone sees events in their local time.
team.tip2: Add the calendar to Google; its updates are not immediate.
